collaboration.description: Session notes or whiteboard Yjs protocol v1. The first frame is JSON auth with a single-use ticket; subsequent sync and awareness frames are binary.

payload.description: A complete ordered snapshot, including an empty list for silence.

Authenticate the connection with either a bearer token (native clients)
or a short-lived single-use ticket (browser clients).
Bar a principal from a room or a session. Unlike removal, this holds.

expires_at.description: Unix seconds. Omitted means until explicitly lifted.

room_id.description:
A room block bars every session in that room; a session block is
narrower. Exactly one of these is set.

payload.description: Short-lived indication; stops automatically without refresh.
Fan out to every authenticated connection.
A reconnect resolves to the same participant as an earlier join.

`code` is stable and machine-readable; `message` carries no internal
detail.

The caller is authorized but not yet admitted. No participant exists
until a capable principal approves the request.
A reconnect to the same session returns the same `participant_id`.

Mute another participant's media for one source.

`kind` is "temporary" (the target may clear it) or "permanent" (only a
moderator may). `source` defaults to the microphone.

actor_id.description:
The target's actor id, not a connection: moderation resolves across
all of a participant's connections.

payload.description:
A participant's mute state changed. Fanned out to the session so every
client's roster reflects it, and sent to the target so it can stop
sending media.

A participation ended. `reason` is "removed" today; carried explicitly so
a later reason does not need a new frame.

source.description:
"microphone" | "camera" | "screen". Omitted means the kind's obvious
meaning: audio is a microphone and video is a camera. This selects
which producers a moderation action applies to; it is never
authorization.

payload.description: End a participant's participation in this session. They may rejoin.

Complete live roster. The version lets clients discard an older frame
after reconnect or a delayed cross-replica wakeup.
Subscribe to a persistent room channel after the last applied event.

Clear a mute. A target may clear its own temporary mute; a permanent one
needs a moderator.
Yjs sync or awareness message encoded with protocol v1

session_id.description: Present when the message belongs to a session conversation.

info.description: JSON signaling over /v1/ws. The API receives client messages and sends server messages. Authenticate with a bearer token on the upgrade request or an auth message before other messages.
info.title: Mahfel WebSocket API
